title: Writing / Style / Punctuation
slide_intent: Match punctuation to the role of the text so small interface labels remain clean while longer statements stay readable.
strategic_value: Role-specific examples can help Duolingo maintain a consistent rhythm across headlines, subheads and buttons.
demonstration: Three stacked comparisons cover headline punctuation, single- versus multi-sentence subheads and a button label.
practical_value: Identify the text role before applying a punctuation convention.

content_islands.name: Guidance column
content_islands.spec: Place the Punctuation heading and explanation of readability and tone at left.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Stack headline, subhead and button rules at right, each followed by preferred and rejected examples.

reference_purposes.Intent: The left copy explicitly connects punctuation with readable chunks and tone.
reference_purposes.Application: Three worked groups distinguish headline, subhead and button usage.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Headlines and single-sentence subheads allow exclamation points but otherwise omit punctuation; multi-sentence subheads punctuate each sentence; buttons never use punctuation.

ingredient.name: Punctuation by text role
ingredient.role: Keep short UI language clear and consistent.
ingredient.application: Omit punctuation from buttons; omit terminal punctuation from headlines and single-sentence subheads except exclamation points; punctuate each sentence in multi-sentence subheads.
ingredient.scope: Historical official guidelines from the 2024–2025 archived snapshot; this records the displayed guidance, not current Duolingo product behavior.
